use_case.problem: Learners need clearer source-linked next steps before human advising appointments.
use_case.required_human_owner: Registrar or advising director for any record-bearing result

data_map.logs: minimal interaction log for error review
data_map.retention: pilot logs deleted after review unless attached to a learner-requested correction
data_map.export_or_continuity_route: advisor summary can be copied into human-owned advising record by staff

authority.queue_or_notification_effects: draft summary only; no hidden queue priority
authority.rollback_route: incorrect summary can be deleted and corrected by advising owner

memory.inspection_or_correction_route: learner may request log correction through advising office
memory.protected_local_record_route: protected facts are redirected to existing support office

evidence_claims.claim: Learners find the next human advising step faster.
evidence_claims.does_not_prove: It does not prove route-equivalence, aid, credit, or standing accuracy.
evidence_claims.public_claim_to_remove_if_weak: Makes advising faster and more reliable

evidence_claims.claim: Learners have a no-deadline-loss correction path for pilot-caused errors.
evidence_claims.does_not_prove: It does not prove all downstream offices will honor corrections without delay.

construct_and_proof.proof_bundle: source links and advisor correction log
construct_and_proof.authentication_or_checkpoint_route: human advisor review for record-bearing questions

accessibility_and_protected_support.no_penalty_fallback: human advisor callback preserves deadline where pilot caused error
accessibility_and_protected_support.bias_or_subgroup_check: pilot compares unanswered and corrected answers by subgroup where permitted
accessibility_and_protected_support.non_misuse_boundary: protected facts are not stored in ordinary advising telemetry

security.retrieved_or_uploaded_content_risk: source freshness and stale page risk
security.data_exfiltration_check: no protected or financial data accepted
security.safe_degradation_and_manual_fallback: turn off assistant and route to advising desk

workload.security_or_it_burden: source freshness check before launch and renewal

decision.required_proof_or_audit: weekly wrong-answer and correction log review
decision.learner_safe_continuity_plan: manual advisor route and no-deadline-loss review

public_summary.what_the_service_does: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — NOT A DEPLOYED SERVICE. Answers source-linked programme navigation questions and helps prepare advisor questions.
public_summary.what_it_does_not_do: It does not decide transfer credit, aid, eligibility, standing, or deadlines.
public_summary.ai_output_record_effect: No record changes without a human record owner.
public_summary.accessibility_and_alternative_path: Accessible interface plus human callback path.
public_summary.claim_limits: Synthetic example only; not a deployed service or local result. The pilot is testing navigation speed and correction routes, not official eligibility decisions.

publication_and_adapters.normalization_notes: Normalized from a realistic advising/navigation example; no real pilot export is represented.
